name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.4-dev.3 (21 Nov): paint schemes from the model packs on 31 China units (Arsenal paint menu, local choice), ZTZ-96/96A/96B commander hatch fixed, Stryker M-SHORAD keeps Lateralus armour prices; plus 0.9.4-dev.2: tank front HEAT tiers, high-end IFV class 700, T-15/VN20 T-80U profile, top-attack ATGMs 11, long-range AAM flash, split cards back, Multiplayer opens Mod Lobbies, launcher reloads 6 s. Includes 0.9.4-dev.1 and 0.9.3. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.49.
